title: 6 Windows + Git traps I hit this week (and the 30-second fixes)
summary:
I spent this week setting up a public GitHub repo on Windows. Almost every problem came from a tiny detail, and the error messages didn't explain any of them. Here are six, with the fixes.
cd /d fails in PowerShell





cd /d C:\Users\me\Desktop\project
Set-Location : A positional parameter cannot be found that accepts argument ...

/d is a Command Prompt option for switching drives. PowerShell doesn't need it. Check your prompt: if it starts with PS, you're in PowerShell, so just run:
cd C:\Use

title: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL now supports direct querying of Apache Iceberg and Parquet data in your data lake
summary: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL now lets you directly query Apache Iceberg and Parquet data stored in your data lake alongside live operational data—no ETL pipelines required. It supports AWS Glue Data Catalog, S3, and S3 Tables, with optimizations like predicate pushdown and caching for efficient performance.
